title: Quenched Festive Middle-Eastern Applesauce Skewers
description: A peppery, creamy, festive dish featuring applesauce, lacquer-glaze, and Middle-Eastern spices, best served at room temperature.

ingredients.name: Lacquer glaze
ingredients.notes: available at Middle-Eastern markets or online

ingredients.name: Pita bread
ingredients.notes: small pieces, toasted for skewer support

instructions: Thread a small piece of toasted pita bread onto a skewer, followed by a small spoonful of applesauce, a sprinkle of garam masala, and a few pieces of unsalted almonds.
Repeat the pattern, leaving a small space between each section.
Brush the lacquer glaze over the applesauce section, then sprinkle with red pepper flakes if using.
Repeat the pattern until the skewer is full, finishing with toasted pita bread on top.
Place the skewers on a roasting pan or a robata grill and cook over medium heat.
Turn frequently until the lacquer glaze is caramelized and the pita bread is toasted.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve at room temperature.
